instructions: Choose which permitted concrete execution request to commission on an explicit resource_id. Capabilities, recorded inventory and timing information inform the choice. Preserve the original job, immutable inputs, constraints and pinned instructions. A resource child owns iterative execution in the shared loop. Receive its requested typed handoff; no infrastructure chooses an approach. Actual received usable handoff completes this launch endpoint with exact zero future credit. Tool-specific and resource instructions are available through knowledge.search, knowledge.entry and knowledge.read. The tool_knowledge context identifies the run-frozen library. Retrieve sections when useful; these instructions do not select work, supply scientific evidence or add execution capabilities. Use the actual tool schemas and caller-owned configuration for execution. Knowledge reads use line coordinates, not scientific source-byte anchors. No manual read is mandatory. Launch software/resource instructions have their own run-frozen library: launch.instructions.search, launch.instructions.entry, launch.instructions.read and launch.instructions.select. The launch_instruction_library context gives its identity. Select any relevant sections from one or several entries; pass the returned selection as launch_instructions in the child assignment. selected_launch_instructions contains exact sections already selected for this assignment. Instructions describe ways to work; they do not select resources, enable tools, override caller constraints, establish current availability or supply scientific evidence. Inventory and fresh observations remain separate. No instruction read or selection is mandatory.
